title: cybianthus roraimae
intro: Cybianthus roraimae, commonly known as the Roraima cybianthus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cybianthus roraimae include acting as an expectorant, which helps in relieving congestion, and also as an analgesic, which reduces pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
